profile_text.body:
ClickUp is a for-profit productivity software startup founded in 2017 and headquartered in San Diego, CA. The company describes its mission as making the world more productive, and it positions its platform as an all-in-one workspace combining tasks, documents, goals, and chat. Its site describes this offering as "the everything app for work."

ClickUp's AI product is called ClickUp AI, categorized as a notes, knowledge, and meetings tool. The platform includes a feature called Brain², which the site describes as having real-time visibility into a user's tasks, documents, and conversations without requiring additional context from the user. ClickUp AI is characterized by the company as covering document generation, task automation, and broad data access. ClickUp also has a presence in the MCP server registry through a third-party server that supports managing ClickUp workspaces by creating, updating, and organizing tasks, lists, folders, and tags.

The site references internal performance figures, reporting a paid return on ad spend of 4.2x across search, up from 3.8x the prior week, and an activation rate of 38%, described as up 4 points month-over-month and the highest since December. The held facts note 174 legal matters with California exposure, though no specific cases are recorded in the available data.
